FFmpeg 8.1.2
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz
License: LGPL version 2.1 or later

Build configuration:
--arch=arm64 --target-os=darwin --enable-shared --disable-static
--disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-ffplay --disable-ffprobe
--disable-network --disable-autodetect --disable-avdevice
--install-name-dir=@rpath

The reproducible build command is in script/build_portable_ffmpeg.sh.
